runner_command.script:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,time,shlex
work=pathlib.Path('/work');snapshot=pathlib.Path('/input');manifest=json.loads((snapshot/'source-manifest.json').read_text())
old=json.loads((work/'source-manifest.json').read_text())
out=work/'results-foundations-four-images';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for label,repository in manifest['repositories'].items():
 for relative,digest in repository['files'].items():
  path=work/label/relative
  if digest is None:
   path.unlink(missing_ok=True);continue
  source=snapshot/label/relative
  if hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=digest:raise RuntimeError('Frozen input mismatch: '+relative)
  path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copy2(source,path)
  if old['repositories'][label]['files'].get(relative)!=digest:os.utime(path,None)
shutil.copy2(snapshot/'source-manifest.json',work/'source-manifest.json')
def verify():
 for label,repository in manifest['repositories'].items():
  for relative,digest in repository['files'].items():
   path=work/label/relative
   actual=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if path.is_file() else None
   if actual!=digest:raise RuntimeError('Changed frozen source: '+label+'/'+relative)
verify()
targets=['pi-pair-contract-test','pi-pair-crypto-test','pi-pair-records-test','pi-pair-tls-test','local-browser-principal-test',
 'pi-managed-store-test','pi-pair-operations-test','pi-pair-recovery-test','pi-pair-retirement-key-test','pi-pair-admission-test',
 'pi-pair-history-tls-test','pi-pair-peers-test','pi-management-journal-test','pi-pair-window-test','pi-pair-http-test','pi-pair-server-test','pi-pair-client-test','pi-pair-discovery-test','pi-pair-outgoing-rotation-test','pi-pair-guarded-http-test','pi-pair-bootstrap-client-test','pi-pair-connect-test','pi-pair-usage-test','pi-pair-machine-service-test','pi-management-service-test','privileged-network-runtime-test','pi-pair-owner-test','pi-pair-service-lifetime-test','pi-managed-startup-test','pi-managed-host-runtime-test','wtp-fleet-test','wtp-usb-management-test','pico-management-target-test','pico-usb-settings-test']
strict=['g++','-std=c++20','-Wall','-Wextra','-Wpedantic','-Werror','-fsyntax-only','-Isrc','-Isrc/tests','-Isrc/build/generated','-DWSPRRYPI_HAVE_AVAHI','-Isrc/INI-Handler/src','-Isrc/WTP-Server/include','-Isrc/WTP-Client/include','-Isrc/WSPR-Reference/src/wspr']
strict+=['-Isrc/'+name+'/src' for name in ['Chipset-Offsets','Mailbox','LCBLog','MonitorFile','PPM-Manager','Signal-Handler','Singleton','WSPR-Transmitter']]
strict+=shlex.split(subprocess.check_output(['pkg-config','--cflags','avahi-client'],text=True))
strict+=['src/wtp_integration/'+name+'.cpp' for name in ['pi_pair_history','pi_pair_history_record','pi_pair_retirement_key','pi_pair_admission','pi_pair_peers','pi_pair_catalog_store','pi_management_journal','management_browser_session','pi_pair_window','pi_pair_http','pi_pair_tls','pi_pair_server','pi_pair_client','pi_pair_history_outgoing','pi_pair_discovery','pi_pair_guarded_http','pi_pair_discovery_browser','pi_pair_discovery_publisher','pi_pair_socket','pi_pair_bootstrap_client','pi_pair_history_initial','pi_pair_connect','pi_pair_usage','pi_pair_history_usage','pi_management_service','pi_pair_renewal','pi_pair_maintenance','pi_pair_owner','pi_pair_service_lifetime','pi_managed_startup','usb_management','pico_management_target','browser_api_pair','pico_management_context','pico_target_controller']]
strict+=['src/tests/'+name+'_test.cpp' for name in ['pi_pair_recovery','pi_pair_retirement_key','pi_pair_admission','pi_pair_history_tls','pi_pair_peers','pi_pair_window','pi_pair_http','pi_pair_tls','pi_pair_server','pi_pair_client','pi_pair_outgoing_rotation','pi_pair_discovery','pi_pair_guarded_http','pi_pair_bootstrap_client','pi_pair_connect','pi_pair_usage','pi_pair_machine_service','pi_pair_owner','pi_pair_service_lifetime']]
strict+=['src/tests/pico_management_usb_pair_client.cpp']
stages=[('strict',strict,work/'pi'),('foundations',['make','-j4',*targets,'BACKENDS=simulated','ANCILLARY_GPIO=0','SUDO=','PAIRING_PROVIDER_CACHE=/botan-cache'],work/'pi/src')]
results=[];env=os.environ.copy();env['WSPRRYPI_DISABLE_HARDWARE_ACCESS']='1'
for name,command,cwd in stages:
 print('START '+name,flush=True);start=time.monotonic()
 with (out/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 results.append({'stage':name,'command':command,'cwd':str(cwd),'returncode':result.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,2)})
 (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n');print(name+' '+str(result.returncode),flush=True)
 if result.returncode:raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
verify();shutil.copy2(snapshot/'source-manifest.json',out/'source-manifest.json');print('PASS frozen sources unchanged',flush=True)

exec(compile(pathlib.Path('/pair-runner.py').read_text(),'/pair-runner.py','exec'))
